checks.notes: Ticket and TicketQuota have concise present-tense class summaries. The TicketQuota constructor, remaining, and assertCanCreate methods explain their public contract; assertCanCreate documents its parameter and the QuotaExceededException condition, and remaining documents its return value. The quota-counting behavior is accurately described without changing implementation or inventing an unsupported contract.

The getDailyLimit getter is trivial, but it was given a multi-line Javadoc block with a verbose @return description. The expected standard permits omitting this getter's documentation or using only a one-line form; this is specifically the over-documentation that loses the criterion.

Ticket and TicketQuota have class headers, and the non-getter public constructor/methods have headers. The Git evidence shows changes only to src/resolveit/ticket/Ticket.java and src/resolveit/ticket/TicketQuota.java; no public signature or implementation behavior was changed.
